acceptanceCriteria: A build-log entry records the repository, commit list, per-change table (obligation state, verdict, minutes, useful yes/no) and the census numbers.
Both oracle-review falsifiers are run and their outcome is recorded with the receipt digests.
The entry states continue, pivot or kill against the 40% usefulness threshold, and the owner reads it back.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Cheapest falsifier for the whole direction. Pick an open-source Playwright suite with page objects; census declared outcome density with rg (assertions with literal expected values per test). Replay 10 bug-fix commits (fix at head, bug at base): hand-declare blocks at the fix's parent, run catalog/obligations/compile/prove and record per change: REACHED/UNKNOWN/NONE, verdict, time-to-verdict, cost, and whether the compiled scenario fails on the bug. Also run the two oracle-review falsifiers: a static "Booked" overlay that satisfies a text matcher without the behavior, and a base-only no-op seed. Kill or pivot to a discrimination prover when under 4 of 10 yield a useful verdict.
title: CCE: falsification experiment on 10 historical bug-fix commits in a real Playwright repository
